dataset.task: Recovery only: return already held cup10mm to original support; not a new pickup episode

scope.authorization_source: User authorized autonomous cup pickup/replacement and recovery. Current camera reconnected and live scene reviewed; return already held cup from10mm probe to original support, no new lift or closure.
scope.source_support_provenance: Exact episode000005 contact_tcp printed in this conversation before reboot; original RAM scope lost. Current pose/visible scene match probe endpoint, all states stable.

metadata.action_semantics: actual MoveL endpoint joint targets plus explicit gripper targets

action_definition.space: absolute joint target degrees (6), gripper target percent (1)
action_definition.source: Explicit keyboard/agent_teacher command.target only; never copied from observed state
action_definition.executed: Caller-reported command flag, preserved in capture.jsonl; hold may be false

timestamp_semantics.frame_index: Sequential journal row index; not an external capture frame index
timestamp_semantics.camera: Original source_timestamp_unix and source_timestamp_monotonic when supplied
timestamp_semantics.robot: Original timestamp and received_monotonic when supplied
timestamp_semantics.command: Original issued_unix and issued_monotonic when supplied
timestamp_semantics.ordering: sync_clock selects the source clock; no nominal LeRobot timestamps are stored

pairing_boundary.rule: Caller supplies last effective operator target at camera time in timing_clock
pairing_boundary.validation: Command issue <= camera capture in the same timing_clock; Unix fields retained for audit
pairing_boundary.limitation: Latched target alongside observation; not a future action, completion proof or acknowledgement
pairing_boundary.training: Review temporal action horizon, synchronization and operator labels before ACT training

dataset.depth_storage: External ContinuousCapture only; no depth file is written by this journal
dataset.discard_policy: Discarded episodes remain on disk for audit; exclude from training
dataset.not_training_ready_reason: Journal-only output needs verified external RGB-D evidence and dataset curation; Episode discarded or interrupted by operator

external_capture.matching_rule: Match camera serial and source timestamp in timing_clock; journal and capture frame indices may differ
external_capture.media_paths: Read rgb_file and depth_file from the matching external capture row; resolve them relative to root

dataset.storage_complete_scope: Successfully flushed journal rows only; external capture completeness is reported separately
dataset.data_valid_scope: Validated observation/issued-command pairs only; external media persistence is not verified here
dataset.recorded_frames_semantics: Successfully flushed capture.jsonl rows; a failed write may leave an unconfirmed tail

continuous_capture.task: Recovery only: return already held cup10mm to original support; not a new pickup episode
continuous_capture.not_training_ready_reason: Raw RPC/JOG events are not continuous target action vectors; outcome and timing also require review.
continuous_capture.timestamp_semantics: timing_clock orders camera/robot/events; original Unix timestamps retained for audit; no hardware synchronization
